Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.23.1 fixes the world-rendered motorcycle appearing green by replacing the legacy grass-green instance-model diffuse tint with white, so the X1 atlas shows its true orange/carbon/silver colors in-world (inventory icons were never affected). v0.23.0 rebuilt the tandem motorcycle visual as the low-poly Wilderness Explorer X1: a 13-part baked model (lofted 16-gon wheels, tubular frame/forks/exhaust, faceted tank, torus-spring shocks) with a 64x64 opaque material atlas, still importing as 1 bone / 13 meshes inside the 1.1,1.25,2.6 collision box. Block 923, the SCIEPortATV GUIDs, two-rider seating, driving, networking and save/load are unchanged; v0.22.3 carriage index-layout fix and all earlier tank/seat/multiplayer fixes remain included. Android/7723 motorcycle rendering is pending real-device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
